crew.overview: Like some other kids, 12-year-old Trevor McKinney believed in the goodness of human nature. Like many other kids, he was determined to change the world for the better. Unlike most other kids, he succeeded.
crew.title: Pay It Forward

details.biography: Chad Dashnaw is an American stunt coordinator and stunt performer. His parents are also stunt coordinators and stunt performers, Jeff Dashnaw and Tracy Keehn-Dashnaw, as well as his brothers J.J. Dashnaw and Jake Dashnaw. His brother Nick Dashnaw was a stunt performer until his death in 2016.
details.name: Chad Dashnaw
